content: Further research opportunities include data harvesting, building standardised datasets and shared tasks for South Africa as well as the rest of Africa. In general, the support for language codes that include more languages seems to be growing, discoverability of research is improving and paywalls seem to no longer be a big problem in getting access to published research.
